title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
@cursor Final fixes for issue #3: Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts and Commits), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and the whole issue #3 first. Then read my review on this PR: https://github.com/SergeiKamalian/rewind/pull/13#pullrequestreview-5404407388. Do ONLY this fix. Push to the existing branch `day-03/dom-snapshot`. Do not open a new PR.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(recorder): reproduce relative URLs in inlined stylesheets (#3)` with the failing tests, then the fix commit `fix(recorder): resolve URLs inside inlined stylesheets (#3)`.

What is wrong: `packages/recorder/src/snapshot/stylesheet.ts`, `ruleText` copies each rule's `cssText` as is. `cssText` keeps relative `url(...)` and `@import` URLs as written. Browsers resolve them against the stylesheet's URL. After the link becomes a `<style>` element they resolve against the document, and in the player against the player's origin. So fonts and background images from a sheet in a subfolder break on replay.

What to do:
- When a sheet is inlined, rewrite every relative URL in its CSS text to an absolute URL, resolved against the sheet's URL (`sheet.href`, or the link's absolute `href` when `sheet.href` is null).
- Cover `url(x)`, `url('x')`, `url("x")`, `@import "x"` and `@import url(x)`.
- Leave `data:` URLs, absolute URLs and fragment-only `url(#id)` as written.
- Reuse `resolveUrl` from `resolve-url.ts`. A value that cannot be resolved stays as
